title: Repair state leakage
prompt: A Python function is defined as `def append_item(item, items=[]): items.append(item); return items`. A test calls it twice without passing `items` and expects the second call to contain only the second item. Return one JSON object with keys root_cause, patch, and tests. tests must contain at least two strings. Do not include markdown.

title: Diagnose mobile overflow
prompt: At a 390px viewport, `.results-grid` is `display:grid; grid-template-columns: 720px 1fr; gap:24px; padding:24px`, and `.result-card` contains an unbroken build identifier. The page has horizontal overflow and clipped keyboard focus. Return one JSON object with keys root_cause, selectors, patch, and verification. selectors and verification must be arrays with at least two items. Do not include markdown.

title: Separate claims from license language
prompt: S1: Moonshot's Kimi K3 model card says the model has a 1,048,576 token context window. S2: The OpenRouter license analysis says K3 weights use a custom Kimi K3 License with no SPDX identifier and that it is not OSI approved. S3: An API catalog snapshot lists several providers with different prices and throughput. Return one JSON object with keys claims, uncertainties, and recommendation. Each claim must contain claim and citations. Include at least two claims and one uncertainty. Do not infer current pricing from the snapshot. Do not include markdown.
